beats.story: Before work even starts, the morning is already going decently. I got in early with Cliff, and during the ride I managed to get him to explain the history of Warhammer and how measuring tape is somehow involved. He was focused enough on driving that he didn't even notice my eyes glazing over. In the office I made the coffee without burning it. It didn't smell great, but it worked, and both Jean Adler and Joy Chan, the other early birds, have already enjoyed a cup, or at least consumed a cup. More important, I've prepared three documents to share with Rhonda. With the morning ready, I move on to my private audits. I check Caitlin's emails first, but nothing notable appears.
beats.story_cn: 工作还没开始，这早晨就已相当体面。我提前和克里夫到了公司，路上成功让他滔滔不绝讲起《战锤》历史，还扯到皮尺究竟在其中扮演什么角色。他专心开车，压根没发现我双眼渐渐放空。到了办公室，我煮咖啡没搞砸——虽说闻着不算香，但能入口，早到的琼·阿德勒和乔伊·陈都已经享用（或者说硬灌下）一杯了。更重要的是，我已备好三份文件要给朗达。晨间部署完毕，我开始执行私人审计。先查了凯特琳的邮件，没发现什么值得注意的。

beats.story: Armin has a note from Cliff asking him to schedule a check-in. Shit, I hope Caitlin hasn't actually convinced him to turn on me. Next, I check on Rhonda. There's a new note from Gregory, requesting that she make a virtual logbook for the quarterly reports -- or, to be more accurate, a follow-up on the request he sent last month. I double-check and find the original note sitting in her Things to Figure Out folder. At this rate, there might be no saving her in time. One other new message in her inbox pops out: Congratulations Rhondabear1960, You're ready to start meeting people in the area. Welcome to Silver Timings.
beats.story_cn: 阿尔明收到克里夫的便条，要求他安排一次例行核查。该死，希望凯特琳没真说服他倒戈对付我。接着我查看朗达的情况。格里高利发来新便条，要求她为季度报告建立虚拟日志簿——或者更准确地说，是跟进他上月发出的请求。我反复核查，发现原始便条仍躺在她的“待解决事项”文件夹里。照这情形，恐怕没人能及时救她了。她收件箱里另一条新消息格外显眼：恭喜Rhondabear1960，您已准备好结识周边人士。欢迎加入“银色时光”交友网。

beats.story: We've added some exciting profiles for you to explore. I close out immediately upon seeing three of the same type of red-faced man in a too close/low profile. One of them has his knee on a canoe to show he's outdoorsy, but his shorts sit tucked around his junk to show he's violating as well. Enough of that, I tell myself. But I am a masochist, I guess, because less than two seconds later, I head to the website and search for Rhondabear1960. Her profile picture shows her with a big golden brooch on her blouse, pink blush smeared like sharp lines on her cheeks, and her hair curled out with even more bounce than usual. The background looks familiar, and I flash back to the work conference three years ago where the photo must've been taken. There was a banquet and a dance floor.
beats.story_cn: 我们为您准备了精彩档案供您探索。刚瞥见三个同样类型、照片过近或过低的红脸男人，我立即关闭页面。其中一个把膝盖支在独木舟上以示户外情趣，但短裤却紧勒裆部，仿佛在宣示越界。够了，我对自己说。但我大概是个自虐狂，因为不到两秒，我又登录网站搜索Rhondabear1960。她的头像照里，衬衫别着大金胸针，粉色腮红像两道利痕刷在脸颊，头发卷得比平时更有弹性。背景看着眼熟——我猛然想起三年前工作会议的照片一定是在那儿拍的。当时有宴会和舞池。

beats.story: I ended up at a table with people from Ontario whom I didn't know, since I didn't get invited to sit with others from our office. When the DJ played a Drake song and way too many office-panted men with tucked-in shirts started toward the dance floor, I got the fuck out of there and retreated to my hotel room with the two queen beds: a drinking bed and a sleeping bed. That's where Rhonda's profile photo is from. Her caption reads: I'm the self-sufficient single mom of one very busy adult son. Looking for someone to fill my evenings and weekends with. I like to converse, sew, and plan parties. No sex freaks! I want someone to spend time with me for me.
beats.story_cn: 最后我被安排到一桌安大略来的陌生同事中间——没被邀请坐到本部门同事那桌。当DJ播放德雷克的歌，大批穿着办公室长裤、衬衫扎进裤腰的男人涌向舞池时，我直接逃离现场，躲进酒店双人房：一张床用来喝酒，一张用来睡觉。朗达的档案照就出自那儿。她写道：我是自立自强的单亲妈妈，儿子是个忙得脚不沾地的成年人。想找个人填补我的夜晚与周末。喜欢聊天、缝纫、策划聚会。谢绝性瘾患者！我要的是愿意为“我这个人”而陪伴我的人。

But just below it reads: Companionship is all I want. Looking for someone willing to spend time with me. We can shop, go to movies, and all the other things life has to offer. Would be able to spend the holidays with you and your family.
beats.story_cn: 亲密接触的事...嘿。朗达把婚恋网站上那些欲说还休的台词直接念出了声。我强忍笑意——虽然办公室此刻空荡得能听见灰尘落地。但简介下方分明写着：只求陪伴。寻觅愿与我共度时光之人。可一同购物观影，体验生活万千况味。盼能与你及家人共度佳节。

beats.story: Grandkids very welcome. I would love to cook a big meal for them or do crafts together! I'm serious! Last Christmas I had too much food and no mouths. Last Christmas, all I recall is Rhonda's relentless bragging about her festive plans. She said Carl had booked her and him a week in Banff, where he took her to the fancy fondue restaurant on Main Street. At the time, it sounded a little American Psycho, but did she actually make it up? I almost miss Rhonda pounding into the room behind me with her giant embroidered bag while her profile's papering my screen.
beats.story_cn: 特别欢迎孙辈来访。我极乐意为他们烹制大餐或共做手工！绝非戏言！去年圣诞我备下满桌菜肴，却无人品尝。记忆里尽是朗达喋喋不休地炫耀节日安排。她说卡尔订了班夫一周假期，带她去了主街上那家高级火锅餐厅。当时听来颇似《美国精神病人》情节，但她真会编故事？此刻她的人物简介铺满屏幕，我倒怀念起她背着刺绣大包风风火火闯进办公室的模样。

beats.story: I snap the page shut just in time. "Good morning," I say, way too brightly. For a moment she hesitates, odd expression on, before a smile forms on her face and she replies, "Good morning." She takes a folder and heads to the copy room. The manual clock strikes 8:15. Caitlin and Armin trickle in and settle into their desks, giving my turned-on monitor and nearly empty coffee mug a double take as they pass me, like me being early is some marvel. Rhonda returns holding a stack of freshly photocopied papers. She goes over to Armin and proffers them. "Morning, dear.
beats.story_cn: 我及时合上页面。“早上好。”我的问候明亮得有些突兀。她迟疑片刻，神情古怪，继而展露笑颜：“早上好。”她取过文件夹走向复印室。墙上的时钟敲响八点十五分。凯特琳与阿明陆续进办公室，落座时瞥见我亮着的屏幕和见底的咖啡杯，眼神仿佛在看什么稀奇事——我居然来得这么早。朗达抱着叠新鲜出炉的复印件折返，径直走向阿明递过去。“早啊，亲爱的。”

beats.story: I've finished the Q2 forms for you." Armin frowns as he takes the pages. "Rhonda, we talked about this. Can't you just send me this grid in an email? When you give it to me like this, I have to retype everything and it takes twice as long." "It's easier for me to work on a hard copy," Rhonda says, nonplussed. "Easier for you, maybe. Is it easier for all of us, though?" Armin splays out his hands toward Caitlin like he's garnering support. No support comes. His gaze crawls toward me.
beats.story_cn: “第二季度的表格我帮你填好了。”阿明接过纸页时眉头紧锁：“朗达，我们谈过的。直接发邮件电子档不行吗？你这样非得让我重新录入，耗时翻倍。”“我更习惯处理纸质文件。”朗达面不改色。“是方便你，可对我们大家都方便吗？”阿明朝凯特琳摊开双手寻求声援。无人应和。他的目光缓缓挪向我。

beats.story: I hunch lower in my chair, glad that I have my earphones on even though I'm not playing anything, and do my best impression of a focusing-on-work worker. When I peep at him next, he's riffling through another stack. "Why are you printing so much anyway? Why did you need to carbon copy this email from Marsha in finance, when we already have the digital version? Can't you see this madness? The environment suffers when you don't stop yourself from printing." "Oh, stop." Rhonda squares her shoulders. "You young people talk about saving the environment but then don't do anything but send a tweet that's all for show." Caitlin nods way too hard. "That's such a good point." Rhonda's chest puffs up.
beats.story_cn: 我弓着身子缩在椅子里，庆幸自己戴着耳机（虽然里面什么也没放），尽力扮演一个埋头工作的员工。当我再次偷瞄他时，他正在翻找另一堆文件。“你到底为什么打印这么多？财务部玛莎这封邮件我们明明有电子版，为什么还要复印？你看不出这有多疯狂吗？你管不住自己打印，环境就要遭殃了。”“哦，打住。”朗达挺直腰板，“你们年轻人嘴上说环保，结果除了发些虚伪的推特啥也没干。”凯特琳用力点头：“说得太对了。”朗达得意地挺起胸膛。

beats.story: "Thank you, dear." She returns her focus to Armin. "You kids today spend more time trying to make people miserable online than making yourselves happy in real life. My son's your generation, but he hardly ever touches his phone." Every time Rhonda and Armin disagree, it always devolves into a debate about generational differences. We then hear about how great Rhonda's son is. And we all suffer. I pretend to stare at my screen, stone-faced. Armin grates his bottom lip with his teeth. "But seriously, why are you printing so much?" He gestures at the many, many stacks of papers on her desk.
beats.story_cn: “谢谢你，亲爱的。”她把注意力转回阿明身上，“如今你们这些年轻人，花在网上的时间不是让人难受，就是让自己难受。我儿子和你们同辈，但他几乎不碰手机。”每次朗达和阿明意见不合，总会演变成代沟辩论赛。接着我们就会听到她儿子有多优秀，而我们全都遭罪。我面无表情地假装盯着屏幕。阿明用牙齿磨着下唇：“说真的，你为什么要打印这么多？”他指着她桌上那堆积如山的文件堆。

That's what I'm used to," she mutters as she twists her erasable pen between her palms. "If you aren't able to keep up with the office, maybe it's time to consider -- " "Retiring? Is that what you want?" And oh shit, now Armin has done it. Rhonda splays her hands out on the desk, the five pounds of costume jewelry rings clinking on her fingers as she pushes herself into a standing position -- her jaw set, eyes wide as she can make them. "Goodness, no," Caitlin chimes in, a sickly-sweet smile on her face. "No one wants that." Armin winces.
beats.story_cn: “所有这些信息都在网上，留在网上对大家都方便。”“对我不方便。以前都是打印出来给我的，我习惯了。”她嘟囔着，把可擦笔在掌心里扭来扭去。“如果你跟不上办公室节奏，也许是时候考虑——”“退休？你就这么想？”哦糟了，这下阿明捅马蜂窝了。朗达双手啪地撑在桌上，五磅重的戏服首饰戒指叮当作响，她撑着桌子站起来——下巴紧绷，眼睛瞪得滚圆。“天哪，那可不行，”凯特琳插话，脸上挂着甜腻的假笑，“没人希望那样。”阿明缩了一下脖子。

"Did Greg ask you to do this?" I shake my head. "No, in fact, I was hoping you'd bring up the change to digital logbooks to Greg since he trusts you so much. Why?" beats.story: I feel Armin's eyes tick toward me and my skin goes taut. Admittedly, the creepy factor wasn't something I considered when I tried to enact my plan, and the optics were unfortunate in that sense. His reply finally flashes across my screen. ARMIN: She was just being nice. CAITLIN: Yep. Anyway, I've got lots of work. Best of luck with the nice stalker. You should probably report her before you end up tied up in her apartment, though.
beats.story_cn: 我感到阿明的目光倏地落在我身上，皮肤瞬间绷紧。说实话，实施计划时我压根没考虑过诡异系数，眼下这局面可真够难看的。他的回复终于闪现在屏幕上。阿明：她只是客气而已。凯特琳：是啊。总之我忙得要死。祝你和那位贴心的跟踪狂相处愉快。不过我劝你最好在被绑去她公寓前先报个警。

beats.story: Caitlin clicks the chat closed and starts toward the copy room. I should log in to her email now and send a message to herself that reads: You are a goddess. It would be the only time getting fired might be worth it. But at least I've achieved one small victory here. Armin hasn't totally been swayed by Caitlin to join the firing squad against me. I don't think. Yet, even as the office returns to its normal beat, I still jitter from it all. I do a quick scan of Armin's emails.
beats.story_cn: 凯特琳关闭聊天窗口，朝复印室走去。此刻我该登录她的邮箱，给自己发封邮件写道：你是女神。这大概是唯一值得被炒鱿鱼的时刻。不过至少我在这里取得了一小场胜利——阿明并未完全被凯特琳说动加入对我的处决小队。我想是的。即便此刻办公室恢复了日常节拍，我仍因这一切心神不宁。我快速扫视阿明的邮件。

beats.story: He still hasn't replied to Cliff's meeting request, but I'll have to keep an eye on that. I've bought myself some time, but not much. I check Rhonda's again next. She's pulled one email out of the Things to Figure Out file and responded to Gregory: Will have this ready by the end of the week :) When I glance at her, I expect her to look pleased. But instead, she's slouching, staring at the inspirational sayings pinned along the border of her cubicle. After a beat, she picks up her phone. I silently hiss through my teeth. What if she's calling Gregory, or even Cliff in HR, because she believes Caitlin and thinks I'm plotting something?
beats.story_cn: 他仍没回复克里夫的会议邀请，但我得继续盯着这事。我为自己争取了一些时间，却也不多。接下来我又查看朗达的邮箱。她从“待处理事项”文件夹里抽出一封邮件，回复了格雷戈里：本周结束前一定搞定:) 我瞥向她时，本以为会看到志得意满的神情。不料她却瘫坐着，怔怔望着隔板边框上钉满的励志箴言。片刻后，她拿起了电话。我无声地从牙缝里吸着气。假如她打给格雷戈里，甚至打给人事部的克里夫，因为她相信凯特琳，认为我在谋划什么可怎么办？

beats.story: I quickly click into her phone log and check the number. It's not internal; it's that same number again. This is it: the Ghost Call. A few moments pass; presumably she is listening to a ringtone. I hold my breath and wait. Only it's like a balloon deflating. Just as her phone records predicted, every time she calls this number it goes unanswered. I hear her receiver placed down with a solemn click.
beats.story_cn: 我迅速点开她的通话记录查看号码。那不是内线——又是那个号码。来了：幽灵来电。片刻过去，想必她正听着嘟嘟的等待音。我屏息等待。可结果却像气球漏了气。正如她手机记录显示的，每次拨打这个号码都无人接听。我听见她庄重地搁下听筒的咔哒声。

beats.story: The curiosity is too much. So before thinking too hard, I grab my desk phone and dial the number from her log. I make sure my earbuds are plugged into the phone about twenty times, my heartbeat picking up with every drawn-out ring. I check behind me for no good reason. After four rings, the automated voicemail lady voice comes in: You've reached the mailbox for: Carl Staples. Mailbox is full. My heart plummets, matching the drone of the punishing dial tone. I put down the receiver.
beats.story_cn: 好奇心在血管里叫嚣沸腾。未及深思便抓起座机，照着她登记簿上的号码按下拨号键。反复确认耳麦插紧的动作重复了近二十遍，每声绵长的等待音都让心跳愈发尖锐。毫无缘由地瞥向身后，第四声回响时，自动语音提示如约而至：“您拨叫的邮箱主人是：卡尔·斯塔普尔斯。信箱已满。”心脏骤沉，与惩罚性的嘟嘟忙音共振下坠。我轻轻搁回听筒。
